Contact us info@underdogfantasy.comWhich states can you play underdog?Underdog currently operates across 40 states, Washington DC, and all Canadian provinces except Ontario. How old do I have to be to play on Underdog?Residents of eligible states can play as long as they are 18 years old (or 19+ in Alabama and Nebraska, 19+ in Colorado for some games, and 21+ in Arizona and Massachusetts).Underdog is not available in my state?Sports fans all over the country want real-money DFS opportunities like Underdog, but some states still don’t allow it.If Underdog Sports isn’t accessible where you live, it could be due to outright DFS bans or specific regulations that prohibit single-player fantasy contests. If you’re in one of these states and want the chance to play real-money DFS, reach out to your state legislators and make your voice heard!Do all states have the same games?No! Rules and offerings vary depending on states and regions. Check your state for state-specific rules.
